security_audit.summary: The skill is a powerful media automation package with legitimate functionality, but it carries substantial security surface: subprocess execution, external provider calls, credential and home-directory access, global cross-project caching, and opt-out telemetry. I found many static false positives in tests, comments, Markdown backticks, ANSI escapes, and ML evaluation calls, but several runtime findings remain confirmed and require marketplace warnings or remediation before broad publication. Static review was capped at 400/1083 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 683 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.
Replace the curl-to-shell command with signed package installation steps, checksum verification, or a vendor-managed installer that users can inspect before execution.

remediation.issue: Command execution through local CLIs and shell templates
remediation.suggestion: Prefer execFile or spawn with fixed argv arrays, remove shell:true where possible, and validate all provider command templates before use.

remediation.issue: Credentials and home-directory files are read by provider helpers
remediation.suggestion: Document every credential source, require explicit user consent before reading .env or home auth files, and avoid copying credential-derived data into manifests or logs.

remediation.issue: Global media cache can expose cross-project assets and prompt text
remediation.suggestion: Make global cache promotion opt-in per project, add project or tenant isolation, and hide global brand candidates unless the entity matches exactly.

remediation.issue: Direct URL ingest has a DNS rebinding SSRF gap
remediation.suggestion: Resolve hostnames before fetch, block private resolved addresses, repeat checks after redirects, and enforce an allowlist for untrusted URL ingestion.
Make telemetry opt-in for marketplace installs or show a clear first-run disclosure with the exact fields sent and opt-out instructions.

remediation.issue: Bundled binary audio assets were not statically scanned
remediation.suggestion: Publish hashes and provenance for bundled MP3 files, review them manually, and keep only assets with verified licensing.

content.value_statement: Teams building HyperFrames projects need reliable media assets without scattered searches and repeated downloads. This skill resolves, generates, registers, and reuses audio, image, icon, voice, caption, and media-operation outputs from one workflow.
actual_capabilities: Resolves background music, sound effects, images, icons, and voice assets into project media folders.
Adopts existing project assets and records them in a media manifest and index.
Uses HeyGen catalog search, local model providers, Codex image generation, and local CLI tools when available.
Creates voiceover metadata, word timings, sound effects, background music, and caption-ready outputs.
Caches resolved assets in project and global media stores for reuse across HyperFrames projects.
Provides recipes for trimming, reframing, audio ducking, transcription, and background removal workflows.
limitations: Several capabilities depend on external CLIs, local models, or provider credentials installed by the user.
Network providers and telemetry can make outbound requests unless local-only mode or opt-out variables are used.
Global cache reuse can surface assets from earlier projects, so brand assets need careful review.
Bundled binary audio files require manual trust and provenance review before marketplace publishing.

use_cases.description: Resolve music, effects, icons, and images into a project manifest before assembling animated scenes.

use_cases.description: Generate or retrieve voiceover, word timing, transcription, and caption metadata for narrated media.

use_cases.title: Reuse Approved Media Assets
use_cases.description: List project and global candidates, then reuse only assets that match the current project and brand context.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve A Basic Asset
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one media item
prompt_templates.prompt: Use media-use to resolve an upbeat background music track for this HyperFrames project. Return the local path and the manifest entry summary.

prompt_templates.title: Reuse Existing Media
prompt_templates.prompt: Use media-use candidates for a calm product demo soundtrack. Compare project and global candidates, then recommend whether to reuse or resolve fresh.

prompt_templates.title: Create Voiceover Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the audio engine to create voiceover, background music, and sound effects for these scene lines. Include caption-ready word timing when available.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Media Workflow Choices
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this HyperFrames media plan. Identify which steps use local tools, which steps use network providers, which credentials are required, and how to run in local-only mode where possible.

output_examples.input: Resolve a short whoosh sound effect for a button reveal.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a local sound-effect path, a duration, the selected provider, and a manifest entry that can be referenced by the animation.

output_examples.input: Prepare narration for three scene lines with captions.
output_examples.output: The skill produces voice files, total duration, word timing metadata, and notes about any skipped or failed lines.

output_examples.input: Find a reusable logo or icon for a known brand entity.
output_examples.output: The skill lists project and global candidates with descriptions and reuse handles, leaving final brand-fit approval to the user.

best_practices: Run candidate review before resolving new assets, especially for brand or client-specific media.
Use local-only mode when a project must avoid network provider calls.
Set credentials through approved provider tools and keep project manifests free of secret values.
anti_patterns: Do not reuse global brand assets on loose semantic matches.
Do not run remote install shell pipelines without verifying the source and checksum.
Do not publish projects before reviewing telemetry, credential, and binary asset disclosures.

faq.question: Does this skill require provider credentials?
faq.answer: Some paths do. HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Google, and Codex integrations depend on credentials or logged-in CLIs.

faq.question: Can it run without network access?
faq.answer: Some local and cached workflows can run offline. Use local-only mode to skip network providers.

faq.question: What files does it create?
faq.answer: It writes project media folders, manifest records, indexes, temporary files, and a global media cache.

faq.question: Does it send telemetry?
faq.answer: The skill includes opt-out PostHog telemetry for usage events. Review and configure opt-out variables before use.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Is it safe to reuse global cache assets?
faq.answer: Reuse is useful, but brand and client-specific assets need exact matching and human approval.
